## Validation

- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `aps schema write`
- [ ] `git diff --exit-code schema`
- [ ] `aps validate`

## 3D-print impact

Describe any changes to geometry assumptions, units, tolerances, printer
profiles, package formats, or physical validation requirements. Write `None`
when the change does not affect printable output.
